_readme: S415 SkyRedbud, 2026-10-18. Eleven of Taft's transfer-degree records print the major's total and 'Total Credit Hours: 60', name 'Completion of Cal-GETC is required' and print no units for it, so the degree check reads them incomplete (e.g. 31443, Early Childhood Education AS-T). This read prints how the program page words its general education and where the catalog states Cal-GETC's units, so a reconcile step can cite the catalog's own figure. Two loads plus the links it follows, no model call.

questions.ge_units: The units the catalog states for Cal-GETC, and how a transfer degree page names it.
